semantic.justification: Consumed native INetURLObject::decode ToIUri and Unambiguous UTF8 branches share original escaped scalar validation, invalid octet preservation and uppercase escapes. Unambiguous uses the exact PART_UNAMBIGUOUS ASCII bit projection from aMustEncodeMap; raw spelling and nonrecursive percent handling remain distinct. Actual HTML named-target filtering consumes it, with shared decoder and real Markdown parser tests. General URL/smart-relative parsing, non-UTF8 charsets and other decode modes remain unported; whole-module and compiled native equivalence are unverified.
